scenes.headline: How a proxy turns coding agents into RL environments
scenes.sub: Train inside unmodified agents by capturing the exact tokens.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Rivet! One small model solves sixty-two percent of tasks in one coding agent, thirty-three in another. Here's how to train inside both.

scenes.text: Don't rewrite the agent. Point it at a proxy that speaks its API, forwards to vLLM, and records the exact tokens and logprobs.
scenes.say: Don't rewrite the agent. Point it at a proxy that speaks its API and records the exact tokens the model sampled.

steps.say: The agent calls what it thinks is a model provider. Its API key is a session id.
The proxy converts the request and asks the inference server for token ids and log probabilities.
It records every sampled token with its probability, then replies in the agent's own format.
Calls link by exact prefix into sequences. Context is masked; sampled tokens are trained.

scenes.title: Why not just save the text?

left.title: Save text, re-tokenize
items: Logprob recomputed, so the ratio is 1
left.say: Save only text, and re-encoding can split it differently. Recompute probabilities later, and the ratio sticks at one.

right.title: Capture at the engine
items: The exact ids the model sampled
The logprob it was sampled with
right.say: Capture at the engine, and every token keeps its real id and probability.

scenes.title: From calls to a graph
scenes.say: Agents retry, spawn helpers and compact history. One rule handles it.

items.say: A call's parent is the longest exact prefix of its prompt.

items.text: A retry is a dead-end sibling
items.say: A retry is a sibling that never continues.
A subagent or a compaction starts a new root.
Each root to leaf path is one sequence.

scenes.title: The reward
scenes.say: One for a correct answer, plus a bonus for fewer tool calls.

parts.note: correct answer; a wrong one scores 0
parts.say: A wrong answer scores zero, so quitting early earns nothing.
The bonus is at most a tenth, but when all eight rollouts are right, it is the only signal.

scenes.title: LFM2.5-2.6B, pass@1 across four agents
scenes.note: one seed each; the RL runs differ by less than the noise
scenes.say: Across four agents, the model climbs from forty-two to fifty-four percent.

scenes.text: Train where the model will run: capture exact tokens at the engine, and rotate the agents.
scenes.say: Train where the model will run. Capture exact tokens, and rotate the agents.

recap: The proxy speaks four model APIs
Exact ids and logprobs, linked by prefix
A small bonus shapes tool use
scenes.say: To recap: one proxy, exact tokens linked by prefix, and a bonus that shapes tool use.
